title: wmp.message.deliver — Notification
description: Deliver a message within a session. Supports both plaintext and MLS-encrypted payloads.

salt.description: Base64url-encoded random salt of at least 16 bytes. Part of the plaintext content object when the sender uses the plaintext commitment (wmp-core §5.2.1); never appears in the outer envelope of an encrypted message.

plaintext_hash.description: Salted commitment to the plaintext content object (wmp-core §5.2.1). Only permitted when wmp.encrypted is true.

value.description: Base64url-encoded (no padding) hash of UTF8(JCS(plaintext content object)).
